incidents.title: Actions jobs started late for over two hours
incidents.impact: About 30% of workflow jobs on GitHub-hosted runners started more than 10 minutes late, and 4% failed to start.
incidents.so_what: Re-run jobs that never started on Nov 12; consider self-hosted runners for release-critical workflows.

incidents.title: Postmortem: Workers KV reads failed for 1h49m on Oct 22
incidents.impact: Workers KV reads failed for 18% of requests worldwide.
incidents.root_cause: A configuration change to the storage gateway's connection limits was rolled out to all locations at once.
incidents.so_what: If Workers read config from KV, check they fail safe when KV errors; Cloudflare now stages these rollouts.

report_markdown:
**Outage watch** 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-16
GitHub Actions jobs started late or not at all for 2h15m on Thursday.

- **GitHub Actions**: workflow jobs delayed. 14:05 to 16:20 UTC on Nov 12 per status page (135 min). About 30% of jobs on GitHub-hosted runners started over 10 minutes late; 4% failed to start. Root cause: not published yet. _For your on-call:_ re-run jobs that never started that afternoon. [incident](https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/a7h3)
- **Cloudflare Workers KV** (postmortem, published Nov 11): reads failed for 18% of requests worldwide, 17:12 to 19:01 UTC on Oct 22 per postmortem. Root cause: a gateway connection-limit change pushed to every location at once. _For your on-call:_ check that Workers reading config from KV fail safe. [postmortem](https://blog.cloudflare.com/workers-kv-outage-2026-10-22/)

_Checked: GitHub (githubstatus.com), Cloudflare (cloudflarestatus.com), AWS us-east-1 (AWS Health Dashboard, quiet)._
